selfImprovement.summary: My self-improvement loop is centred on traces, observations, replay, and weekly improvement. Trace analyser at 03:00 studies routing, plans, needsPlan quality, timing, and anomalies from reasoning-traces.jsonl. Ground truth at 03:30 verifies factual claims against authoritative sources. PROBE turns those signals into weekly observations. IMPROVE on Saturday 22:00 grooms the week's observations, synthesises evidence-backed candidates, and may implement one via a worktree-based pipeline.
selfImprovement.evalSuite: The regression suite covers router behavior, needsPlan labels, trace analysis, output filtering, group modes, pending actions, topic indexing, overnight pipeline components, and security scenarios. Run with: npm test

theForge.summary: The old 04:30 Forge orchestration has been replaced by the Phase 5 IMPROVE stage. IMPROVE is the weekly deep self-improvement pass that consumes the current week's observations, selects the best evidence-backed candidate, and can produce either a worktree-based implementation or a proposal card.
theForge.pipeline: IMPROVE reads this week's observations, grooms and deduplicates them, synthesises final candidates via EVO, runs Opus selection (nullable), optionally implements in a fresh worktree, runs replay-based regression checks, and then either deploys branch-first or writes a proposal card for later review.
theForge.safeguards: Weekly budget caps, evidence-reference requirements, replay regression checks, worktree isolation, banned files, and proposal-card fallback when auto-merge is not safe. The system prefers proving an improvement over merely producing code.
theForge.skillContract: Forge-authored skills remain runtime-augmenting post-processors discovered at startup, but the governing overnight coding path is now the IMPROVE stage rather than the retired forge-orchestrator.
